text_block_list.name: Kurumi
text_block_list.text:
I-it's back again.
And it looks even stronger than last time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
また現れたけど、
さっきより強くなっているみたいだよぉ……

text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text:
The energy surging from it is almost suffocating.
Is this true extent of Foggy's power...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんて凄まじい魔力……
まさかあれが、
フォギーの本当の力だというの……？

text_block_list.name: Ayane
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Even I'm a bit scared now.
But I won't give in! We're gonna beat it down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
さすがの私もちょっと怖いけど……
ぜったいに負けたりしないんだからぁ！
